description: Dress a model image with a one-piece outfit or suit image, supporting optional garment and model masks.

fields.name: suitOriginUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the original one-piece garment image. The image must be up to 20 MB and between 385 and 4096 pixels in both width and height.

fields.name: modelImageUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the model image.

fields.name: suitImageUrl
fields.description: Optional processed suit mask or crop URL.

fields.name: modelMaskImageUrl
fields.description: Optional mask URL for the model body area.

fields.name: outputNum
fields.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4. Defaults to 1.
